intro.title: Triplets
intro.text: A triplet fits three notes into the time of two, marked with a 3. Three triplet eighths fill one click: count “1-trip-let, 2-trip-let”.

intro.title: Straight vs triplet
intro.text: Bar 1 is straight eighths (two per click), bar 2 is triplets (three per click). Bar 5 has quarter-note triplets: three across two clicks.
